def find_neighbors(graph, node):
    # Convert the graph to an adjacency matrix for efficient graph traversal
    adj_matrix = nx.to_numpy_array(graph)
    # Use np.nonzero to find all nodes connected to the input node

    # Use set intersection to find nodes that are shared neighbors of both input nodes
